boxes.text: Two files, 14 KB gzipped: the loader and the table of chunk names.
Every module two or more components share becomes its own file: 109 files under 2 KB on a typical page.
Each component chunk holds only that component's private code.
Modules used by 10 chunks or more move into one `atomic-shared` file, 47.6 KB gzipped, loaded by every page; the others stay one file each.
Unchanged by construction: the enforced groups touch async chunks only.
Modules reached by the same pages form a group; the solver merges groups into a core every page loads, then chunks shaped by which pages combine what.
Components that always load together share one chunk.
